trust.label: Ownership
trust.heading: What you get to keep.
trust.t1: You own the code, outright, from day one.
trust.b1: No page builder, no theme, no licence that expires.
trust.b2: The site is plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Any developer can continue it.
trust.b3: Right-to-left is built in, not bolted on. This site is the proof.
trust.b4: Canonical structure, hreflang, structured data and clean markup from the start.
trust.b5: Analytics and attribution are prepared, and configured where you have the accounts.
trust.b6: You see the site before it launches, and you approve what goes live.

faq.label: Questions
faq.heading: Straight answers.
faq.q1: How long does a ZOHAR website take to build?
faq.a1: A marketing site is typically 3 to 7 working days once the brief is agreed and the content is with us. Stores and systems are quoted individually, with the timeline set before work starts.
faq.q2: What exactly do I own at the end?
faq.a2: The full source: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, images and configuration. You can host it anywhere and any developer can continue it. There is no licence to renew and no platform to stay on.
faq.q3: How many rounds of changes are included?
faq.a3: Two consolidated revision rounds, within the brief we agreed. Each round comes to us as one list rather than messages spread over weeks, which is what keeps the timeline and the price predictable. An additional round is ₪650. Work outside the agreed brief — a change of direction, extra pages, new functionality — is ₪300 per hour or quoted up front.
faq.q4: Do you work in languages other than Hebrew and English?
faq.a4: Yes. Multilingual implementation is part of the service, and right-to-left languages are handled properly rather than mirrored as an afterthought.
faq.q5: Can you move my existing WordPress site?
faq.a5: Where it is genuinely deliverable, yes — we rebuild the content in owned code rather than migrating the plugins. We will tell you honestly if your site is a poor fit.
faq.a6: No. We build the structure that makes results possible and we prepare the measurement that shows whether they happened. Anyone guaranteeing a number before seeing your market is guessing.
faq.q7: What does it cost, and how is it paid?
faq.a7: The final proposal is defined after a short brief and depends on scope, languages and functionality — online stores, multilingual websites and custom systems are quoted separately. Payment is 50% at project start and 50% before production launch. Domain registration and paid third-party services are not included.
faq.a8: Not yet. It is in development. Today every ZOHAR website is created through the Done-For-You process, and we do not take payment for anything that is not ready.
faq.q9: What happens to hosting after the first year?
faq.a9: The first year of secure managed static hosting is included, subject to reasonable use. Domains, paid third-party services, abnormal traffic and paid server functions sit outside it. After that you can renew hosting and basic management at ₪600 per year, or move the code to your own hosting account — it is your code, so there is no dependency on us either way.

privacyPage.metaDescription: How ZOHAR AI handles information on this website and when you contact us.
privacyPage.label: Privacy
privacyPage.heading: Your information, explained clearly.
privacyPage.intro: This website is designed to collect as little information as possible. This page describes what happens today, without assuming future tools.
privacyPage.s1b: If you contact us by email or WhatsApp, we receive the information you voluntarily send so we can answer your enquiry and, where relevant, prepare a proposal.
privacyPage.s2b: Your answers remain in browser memory and are not posted to a server or stored by this website. Only after you choose WhatsApp or email are they passed to the selected app, and they are sent only when you confirm there.
privacyPage.s3b: The website currently uses no analytics service, advertising pixel or marketing cookie. If that changes, the necessary information and, where required, consent choices will be added before activation.
privacyPage.s4b: Our hosting provider may process limited technical data such as IP address, device type and security logs to serve and protect the website. We do not use those logs to create marketing profiles.
privacyPage.s5b: Links to WhatsApp, email and project websites take you to external services governed by their own privacy policies.
privacyPage.s6b: Direct correspondence is kept only for as long as it is useful for handling your enquiry or required by an applicable obligation. You may ask us to access, correct or delete information you sent us.
privacyPage.contactBody: For a privacy question or request, email support@zoharai.com.

accessibilityPage.metaDescription: ZOHAR AI website accessibility commitment and features.
accessibilityPage.label: Accessibility
accessibilityPage.heading: An experience designed for more people.
accessibilityPage.intro: We aim to meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA and improve the website whenever we identify a real barrier.
accessibilityPage.s1b: The website uses semantic headings, regions and links, a skip link, a logical focus order and keyboard-operable navigation.
accessibilityPage.s2b: Text size, contrast, focus states and resizing are designed to remain readable on phones, tablets and desktop screens.
accessibilityPage.s3b: Reduced-motion preferences are respected. Important motion can be paused, and no essential video depends on sound.
accessibilityPage.s4b: Every page declares its language and reading direction. Hebrew and left-to-right languages use layouts adapted to them, not a simple visual flip.
accessibilityPage.s5b: External portfolio websites are outside our control. Despite our checks, a problem may also appear on a particular device or assistive technology.
accessibilityPage.s6b: Tell us the page, the action you were trying to complete, your device and assistive technology. We will review the issue and seek a practical solution.

termsPage.metaDescription: Terms governing use of the public ZOHAR AI website.
termsPage.label: Terms
termsPage.heading: Website terms of use.
termsPage.intro: These terms apply to the public website. A client project is governed by its proposal and service agreement, which take precedence for that project.
termsPage.s1b: The website presents ZOHAR’s current services, authorised work and a clearly labelled roadmap. It is not a promise that products marked as future or in development are available.
termsPage.s2b: The displayed starting price is not a proposal. Scope, timing, languages, functionality, payments and responsibilities are defined in a separate proposal or agreement.
termsPage.s3b: Unless stated otherwise, this website’s design, text, brand and code belong to ZOHAR or are used with permission. Rights delivered to a client are those defined in that project’s agreement.
termsPage.s4b: Captures reflect projects when they were prepared. External destinations may change, become unavailable or apply their own terms.
termsPage.s5b: You must not attempt to disrupt the website, bypass its protections, extract its content at scale or use the brand in a way likely to create confusion.
termsPage.s6b: We work to keep information accurate and the website available, without guaranteeing uninterrupted operation or a particular business result. Project-specific limits are defined in its agreement.
termsPage.contactBody: For a question about these terms, email support@zoharai.com.
